shear_correction_factor.source_scope_note: Reddy derives 5/6 explicitly for a homogeneous rectangular section; the value is not repeated in the caption of Table 4.3.3 and is not a universal property of an arbitrary laminate.
shear_correction_factor.implementation_policy: K is an explicit input. The source benchmark factory supplies 5/6. It must not be fitted separately by laminate or case.

equation_4_3_50a.solver_policy: Do not assemble the solver from the printed intermediate line. Derive the clamped boundary matrix directly from the physical first-order state and w = psi = 0. Use Eq. (4.3.51) only as a secondary check.

homogeneous_representation.required_check: partition invariance for A, B, D, shear matrix, I0, I1, I2, reduced beam properties, and frequencies

missing_rows.policy: Do not reconstruct missing numerical values and do not include them in source PASS/FAIL.
missing_rows.project_diagnostic_policy: A project no-RI result may be computed, but the source_value remains null and the source_status remains NOT_PUBLISHED_IN_TABLE.

reddy_thickness_coordinate.source_location: printed page 113 / PDF index 135; stacking rule on printed page 142 / PDF index 164

project_storage_convention.scope_note: The mapping is explicit. It does not alter the current palindromic symmetric benchmark stacks, but it must not be ignored in a future B != 0 model.

coordinate_and_ordering.ply_stack_direction: project storage: bottom-to-top in increasing z_project

material_definition.realization_policy: Absolute E2 and rho are not source-fitted; the normalized frequency is invariant under consistent positive E2 and rho scaling.

source_classical_characteristic_roots.usage: Only source_classical_characteristic comparison rows use these source-printed roots; analytic gates use independently solved full-precision roots.

tier_definitions.A: Source-explicit 0° and 90° laminates; all printed frequency rows for a/h = 100, 20, 10 and HH, CC, CF. The single global benchmark input K = 5/6 has the same inferred provenance as in Tier B.
tier_definitions.B: Source-corrected/inferred (0/90)_s and (45/-45)_s cases with K = 5/6; only actually printed frequency rows for a/h = 100, 20, 10 and HH, CC, CF.

row_role_definitions.description: frequency calculated using the source classical characteristic equation with rotary inertia retained in the frequency calculation
frequency calculated using the source classical characteristic equation without rotary inertia

printed_tolerance_rule: half unit in the last printed decimal place
